page.name: File Naming Convention
page.intro: Learn how to name files and documents for the public using the department file-naming convention.
page.content:
If you are saving files for public viewing/download, they should be named according to a convention that captures the area of focus, description of the content, and date in a standard format to ensure consistency and searchability.

Team/Area - Title of File - Full Date

  • Spaces between hyphens
  • No abbreviations or acronyms (unless universal or a specific project/program within the department that would be recognizable to all)
  • Date with periods in between and the full year is written out, and no leading 0's - 6.1.2024
  • PDFs must be used unless you share a document where most of the document is meant for the end user to edit the contents or an Excel document with formulas.

Examples:

  • Assessment – Print Disability Flowchart – 5.15.2024.pdf
  • Outdoor Education – Maine Outdoor Learning Grant Application – 5.15.2024.pdf
  • MLTI – Sphero Tutorial – 5.15.2024.pdf
  • School Safety – Restorative Practices Brochure – 5.15.2024.pdf
  • Child Nutrition – USDA Pricing Sheet – 5.15.2024
